fields.headline: County officials to brief media on storm response at 3 PM
fields.what: News conference on road closures, shelters and the rumor about the water supply
fields.where: County Emergency Operations Center, 120 Harbor Street; livestream on the county website
fields.who: County Executive; Sheriff; Director of Public Works
fields.details: Reporters should check in at the front desk by 2:45 PM. A question period follows the statements.
